description: Changes the business's Showcase photos as the Photos page does: op pair or merge (photo_ids [before, after]), unpair or swap_sides (photo_ids [one]), favorite (photo_ids and value true/false), unpublish or delete (photo_ids 1-500). photo_ids and company_id come from read entity showcase_photos (company_id is the Showcase company the org is linked to). Visual pair alignment (dragging images) stays on the Photos page. The change returns through Showcase's feed. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first result. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.
